member.name: T:CIS.Logging.LogValue
member.summary: An immutable, explicitly typed scalar or owned collection of attribute values.
member.remarks: Collection inputs are copied; already immutable child values may be shared. Every collection root is node 1 at depth 1; retained shapes have at most 1024 nodes and depth 8. Oversized collections keep a bounded projection and carry truncation provenance. UUID/time factories accept typed scalars; arbitrary objects have no conversion path. Event capture/rendering applies the separately configured aggregate entry limit.

member.name: P:CIS.Logging.LogValue.Kind
member.summary: Gets the constructor-selected representation; magnitude never changes it.

member.name: P:CIS.Logging.LogValue.IsTruncated
member.summary: Gets whether this value or a retained descendant has omitted content.
member.remarks: Collection projection propagates prior and newly observed truncation. Aggregate entry-byte projection remains an event capture/rendering responsibility.

member.summary: Creates invariant non-exponent decimal text, preserving fractional precision.
member.remarks: A fractional part is required; trailing zeros and negative decimal zero are preserved.
member.exception: value is not an invariant decimal representation.

member.summary: Creates a lowercase UUID string in hyphenated 8-4-4-4-12 form.
member.remarks: All Guid values, including Guid.Empty, are valid attribute scalars.

member.name: M:CIS.Logging.LogValue.Timestamp(System.DateTimeOffset)
member.summary: Creates a UTC timestamp with exactly seven fractional digits.
member.remarks: The supplied offset is converted to the same UTC instant; formatting is invariant.

member.name: M:CIS.Logging.LogValue.Array(System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable{CIS.Logging.LogValue})
member.summary: Creates a bounded owned array, preserving input order.
member.remarks: The root counts as node/depth 1. At most 1024 nodes and depth 8 are retained. Copying stops after the first excess child; observed invalid children remain errors.
member.exception: items contains a null reference instead of LogValue.Null().

member.name: M:CIS.Logging.LogValue.Map(System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyDictionary{System.String,CIS.Logging.LogValue})
member.summary: Creates a bounded owned ordinal map, preserving key text.
member.remarks: The root counts as node/depth 1. At most 1024 nodes and depth 8 are retained. Structural projection keeps the enumeration prefix and stops at the first excess child. Retained keys compare ordinally; observed invalid keys/children remain errors.
member.exception: A key is empty, malformed, contains controls, exceeds 255 scalars, occurs twice, or a value is a null reference instead of LogValue.Null().
